name: level select
description: Options > Mods > level select: one row that opens the list at once (no off / on switch; the mod counts as on for the session the moment the list opens). Every level, boss and area of the game (docs/COMPLETION_MAP.md's 26 rows by display name) started through the game's own saved-level path (GameController::WarpToChunk: the progress taken as a save would, the chunk and the character written over it, the level loaded as a save's would be). Saves made with it on go to the -mods card.
